title: Whack-a-Mole Arcade
description: Grab your cartoon mallet and bop cheeky helmeted moles popping out of meadow burrows—chain fever combos while sparing innocent critters and bombs.
controls: Tap rapidly on popping moles to score combo streaks while avoiding bombs and penalty targets.

zh-CN.title: 欢乐打地鼠
zh-CN.description: 全民童年街机欢乐打地鼠：拿起大木槌眼疾手快猛敲冒头捣蛋地鼠，连击狂暴加分注意别敲到炸弹哦！
zh-CN.controls: 眼疾手快点击冒出洞口的调皮地鼠得分，避开炸弹刷新限时最高纪录。
